heading: Bank Holiday on November 9, 2026: What It Means for Your Finances
tldr: Banks in several Indian cities will observe holidays on Monday, November 9, 2026, for festivals like Diwali, Laxmi Puja, Govardhan Puja, and Vishwakarma Day.
These closures primarily affect physical bank branches, impacting services like cash withdrawals, deposits, and cheque processing.
Digital banking channels, including UPI, Net Banking, and Mobile Banking, will remain operational 24/7 for most transactions.
The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) publishes a detailed calendar of bank holidays, which varies by state and specific festival.
It is crucial for individuals to check the official RBI holiday calendar for their specific city to confirm branch closures and plan financial activities accordingly.
caption:
Heads up! Your bank might be closed on November 9, 2026, for upcoming festivals. This mainly affects visiting branches for things like cash or cheques. But don't worry, your online banking and UPI will still work around the clock! It's super important to check if your city's banks are closed so you can plan ahead.
